name: preauth
description: Prior authorization review copilot: supervisor + clinical evidence, policy/RAG, coverage/eligibility, criteria/quality agents. Reviews synthetic PA cases and returns cited, human-reviewable recommendations.

skills.name: Review PA case

skills.name: List cases
